chunks: The one who takes back his gift is like the one who returns to his vomit.

key_terms.اَلْعَائِدُ: the one who returns or goes back
key_terms.قَيْئِهِ: his vomit; used here as a severe likeness to show repulsiveness
key_terms.هِبَتِهِ: his gift; something voluntarily given to another

ai.seo_question: What does the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم say about taking back a gift after giving it?
ai.summary: This hadith strongly condemns taking back a gift after giving it. It uses a vivid comparison to show the ugliness of revoking a gift and teaches proper conduct in dealings with others.
